```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)

# Set your API key in your session or .Renviron (e.g., FANTASYPROS_API_KEY="your_key")
Sys.setenv(FANTASYPROS_API_KEY = "JEKXmltF561k7aEeZh6FX4oc8QZEXaI91pmA9LZz")

# Core Request Helper
fp_request <- function(endpoint, query_params = list()) {
  api_key <- Sys.getenv("FANTASYPROS_API_KEY")
  if (api_key == "") {
    stop("API Key not found. Please set `Sys.setenv(FANTASYPROS_API_KEY = 'your_key')`.")
  }
  
  req <- request("https://api.fantasypros.com/public/v2/json") %>%
    req_url_path_append(endpoint) %>%
    req_headers(`x-api-key` = api_key) %>%
    req_url_query(!!!query_params) %>%
    req_user_agent("R_FantasyPros_Client/1.0") %>%
    # Automatically handle HTTP 429 and 5xx errors
    req_retry(
      max_tries = 5,
      backoff = ~ 2^.x # Waits 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s on retries
    )
  
  res <- req %>%
    req_perform() %>%
    resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)
  
  return(res)
}
```

Endpoint Wrappers
1. Expert Consensus Rankings (ECR)

Retrieves aggregated consensus rankings filtered by sport, season, position, and scoring system (e.g., PPR, HALF, STD).

```{r}
get_fp_consensus_rankings <- function(
    sport = "nfl",
    season = 2026,
    position = "RB",
    scoring = "HALF",
    limit = 100
) {

  endpoint <- sprintf(
    "%s/%s/consensus-rankings",
    sport,
    season
  )

  params <- list(
    position = position,
    scoring = scoring,
    limit = limit
  )

  response <- fp_request(
    endpoint,
    query_params = params
  )

  as_tibble(response$players) |>
    janitor::clean_names()
}

get_fp_consensus_rankings_all <- function(
    sport = "nfl",
    season = 2026,
    position = "RB",
    scoring = "HALF",
    page_size = 10,
    sleep_sec = 5
) {

  endpoint <- sprintf(
    "%s/%s/consensus-rankings",
    sport,
    season
  )

  all_players <- list()
  offset <- 0

  repeat {

    message(
      "Fetching ", position,
      " rankings: offset = ", offset
    )

    params <- list(
      position = position,
      scoring = scoring,
      limit = page_size,
      offset = offset
    )

    response <- fp_request(
      endpoint,
      query_params = params
    )

    players <- response$players

    if (is.null(players) || length(players) == 0) {
      break
    }

    players <- as_tibble(players)

    message(
      "  Received ",
      nrow(players),
      " players"
    )

    all_players[[length(all_players) + 1]] <- players

    # Stop when fewer than requested are returned
    if (sum(sapply(all_players, nrow)) >= 20) {
      break
    }

    offset <- offset + nrow(players)

    # Additional delay on top of fp_request's rate limiter
    Sys.sleep(sleep_sec)
  }

  message("Number of pages: ", length(all_players))
  message("Rows by page: ", paste(sapply(all_players, nrow), collapse = ", "))
  
  result <- bind_rows(all_players)

  message("Total rows after bind_rows: ", nrow(result))
  
  bind_rows(all_players) |>
    janitor::clean_names()
}
# Example Usage:
 rb_rankings <- get_fp_consensus_rankings_all(position = "RB", scoring = "HALF")
```

```{r}
get_fp_projections <- function(sport = "nfl", 
                               season = 2026, 
                               position = "QB", 
                               week = "0") {  # 0 for season-long, 1-18 for weekly
  
  endpoint <- sprintf("%s/%s/projections", sport, season)
  params <- list(position = position, week = week)
  
  response <- fp_request(endpoint, query_params = params)
  
  projections_df <- as_tibble(response$players) %>%
    janitor::clean_names()
  
  return(projections_df)
}

fetch_all_projections <- function(positions = c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE"), season = 2026) {
  positions %>%
    set_names() %>%
    map_dfr(~ get_fp_projections(season = season, position = .x), .id = "position_requested")
}

all_projections<-fetch_all_projections()
```
